dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: That’s great to hear—thank you! Can you tell me what my interest rate is, and what the total costs of this loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has an interest rate of 5.750%. The total loan costs, which include origination charges and other associated fees, are $5,565.35. Let me know if you’d like details on any other aspect of your loan.

dialogue.user: Thanks for those details. Could you please tell me if my loan has any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags? Also, has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution yet?

dialogue.user: Thanks for clarifying that. One last question: what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application? Was it a factor in my approval?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is 42%. This ratio compares your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income.
